deoxygenation_method: Offline argon sparging of all Stage 1 feed solutions (EtOH/pH 9 buffer 5:1 v/v) for ≥20 min; transfer to sealed glass reservoirs with argon headspace; maintain argon blanket on reservoirs during entire run. No inline degasser used (forbidden by hard constraint). Purge Stage 1 tubing with degassed solvent before reaction start.

topology_operations.label: Pump A — Substrate and photocatalyst dissolved together in pre-degassed EtOH/pH 9 buffer (5:1 v/v); fed from argon-blanketed sealed reservoir via HPLC pump
Pump B — Michael acceptor in pre-degassed EtOH/pH 9 buffer (5:1 v/v); separate stream allows stoichiometry tuning; fed from argon-blanketed sealed reservoir via syringe pump
PhotoCoil — Photoredox Giese radical addition (C–C bond formation)
MFC C — Air introduced via T-junction into the Stage 1 outlet stream to create gas-liquid segmented (Taylor) flow for efficient O2 mass transfer; delivered by syringe pump or pressurized gas line
